title: Every module is a directed colimit of finitely presented modules
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M$ an $R$-module. There exist a small nonempty directed partially ordered set $I$, finitely presented $R$-modules $M_i$ for $i\in I$, transition maps $f_{ij}:M_i\to M_j$ for $i\le j$, and compatible maps $f_i:M_i\to M$ identifying $M$ with the colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of this directed system. Here finitely presented means the cokernel of an $R$-linear map between finite free $R$-modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].
